rwa_claim_audit.key_correction: Tokenized asset value/represented value is a stock or valuation metric, not transaction settlement volume, cash inflow, XRP purchases or XRP demand.

april_24_2026_claim.video_claim: $3.5B of tokenized real-world assets settled over 30 days and approximately $900M moved in one day.
april_24_2026_claim.source_report: CryptoBasic/Blockonomi reported RWA.xyz value rose from $2.616B (including $491M stablecoins) on Apr 22 to $3.53B, a $895.6M value increase.
april_24_2026_claim.driver: Justoken JMWH value reportedly rose from $861M to $1.763B; existing asset repricing/indexing, not a demonstrated $900M payment/settlement flow.
april_24_2026_claim.disconfirming_evidence: The same report says Justoken's official platform still displayed approximately $860M and had not confirmed the higher RWA.xyz figure; a data/indexing anomaly remained possible.

later_definition_reconciliation.interpretation: Distributed was less than one-tenth of the reported RWA total; stablecoins were counted separately.
Represented and distributed are distinct; stablecoins tracked separately.
Multiple XRPL headline totals differ because datasets mix distributed assets, represented assets, RLUSD and sometimes ETF-related liquidity.
A single energy token dominates the represented market-value figure; not a broad diversified pool of liquid securities.

rwa_claim_audit.counter_hypothesis: The ledger may be hosting genuine, economically backed energy contracts and institutional records even if tokens are not freely transferable or actively traded. Represented value can still have utility for issuer-side recordkeeping, but does not prove liquid collateral or demand for native XRP.
rwa_claim_audit.required_metrics: Track represented vs distributed, holder concentration, issuer confirmation, transferable supply, transfer volume, active counterparties, on-chain payments by asset, XRP actually used as bridge inventory, and native XRP balance/turnover separately.

official_xrpl_docs.design: Single Asset Vaults can hold XRP, trust-line assets such as RLUSD, or MPTs; Lending Protocol design uses uncollateralized fixed-term loans and off-chain credit assessment, with first-loss capital and optional additional collateral logic.

official_amendment_rule.rule: More than 80% of trusted validators must support an amendment for two weeks; if support falls to 80% or below, the clock restarts.

independent_live_dashboard.interpretation: Dashboard's displayed roll-call timestamp is six minutes later than its displayed page-fetch timestamp. Treat vote counts as provisional; official XRPL documentation still labels institutional credit open for voting.

xls_65_66_status.important_distinction: XLS-65/66 proposals do not prove active native lending, deployed XRP collateral, live credit utilization, or XRP demand. XLS-66 is uncollateralized at its core; optional collateral requires additional design.
